name: Hazuki Kei
source:
Outstanding grades and an all-around athlete. On top of that, he is a high school model whose popularity is skyrocketing. He is usually quiet and blunt, and often seems to be on his own around school. Though he can be a bit difficult to approach at first, once you grow close, his gentleness begins to show—as well as the reason he prefers solitude...

[Translated from the [url=http://www.tokimemo-type.com/tkmkgstype/character/index.html]official website[/url]]
